book1Ch9John1_11_13.basis: PUSEY-V1-P131-JPG..PUSEY-V1-P136-JPG (A1 visual scans, Pusey I pp. 131-136)
book1Ch9John1_11_13.distinction: All the world is Gods own by creation (kata ge ton tou pepoiestai logon, p. 131.16-18), Israel specially as prototokos (p. 131.21-22), while believers through faith receive authority to be ranked among Gods children by grace and regeneration of the Spirit (pp. 133-136).

book6John8_46_47.basis: PUSEY-V2-UOFT-0117-TXT..0120-TXT (C OCR of Pusey II pp. 105-108 + Wave 5 A1 English)
book6John8_46_47.distinction: Separates universal origin from God as Creator (katho panton esti demiourgos, p. 106.9-10) from filial hearing of Gods word (en teknois katatattein, p. 106.11-13).

book6Ch1John10_14_16.basis: PUSEY-V2-UOFT-0239-TXT..0248-TXT (C OCR of Pusey II pp. 227-236, continuous MS B + Wave 5 A1 English)
book6Ch1John10_14_16.distinction: Incarnational kinship and bodily resurrection encompass all human nature (holen heauto synanistontos ten anthropou physin, p. 233.20-21) yet not equally for all (me men en iso pasin, p. 233.15): unbelievers rise to punishment without saving profit, whereas foreknown sheep united with called Gentiles receive true kinship (syngeneia alethes) and eternal life.

book7FragJohn11_44.basis: PUSEY-V2-UOFT-0303-TXT..0305-TXT (C OCR of Pusey II pp. 291-293) + Wave 8 A1 Praefatio p. ix
book7FragJohn11_44.distinction: Composite catena unit: lines 1-14 move from general resurrection sign to Mal 4:2 fulfilled in us through faith, whereas the second paragraph at p. 292.15-23 (margin 691 A) is explicitly rejected by Pusey Praefatio p. ix as non-Cyrilline (illius non est).

book7FragJohn11_49_52.basis: CRAMER-V2-P322-JPG (A1 visual scan of Coislin 23 catena, Cramer II p. 322.19-29) + PUSEY-V2-UOFT-0306..0308-TXT & PUSEY-V2-GOOG-0304..0306-TXT (two independent C OCR streams of Pusey II pp. 294-296) + Wave 4 A1 English
book7FragJohn11_49_52.distinction: Cramer II p. 322 visually confirms the Greek c/l/Cord. recension (Genos tou Theou pantes anthropoi... Synagage de palin kai synekomise pantas dia tes pisteos ho Christos eis mian aulen ten Ekklesian), displaced after John 12:8 and anonymous in Coislin 23 without the fuller Cat. Harl. frame; Pusey II 294-296 and PG 74 cols. 69-70 still lack visual page scans.

GRG-1.finding: Repairs conflated Bliss leaf 44 gloss: Gregory writes sine aestimatione (priceless blessing, Mor. I.24.33 col. 524C), not sine pretio, and explicitly uses redimendo / ut redimeret (cols. 612B, 642B) alongside rejection of devil-bargain.

CHR-2.basis: CRAMER-V2-P319-JPG..P320-JPG (A1 visual scans) + OG-CHRYS-IN-JOANNEM-JSONL & GAUME-CHRYS-0472..0473-TXT (C OCR)
CHR-2.finding: Verifies Greek catena text apo tou mellontos esesthai (p. 320.21-22) and unbroken hina synagage eis hen sentence (p. 320.25-26), while recording catena apellagesan polloi (p. 320.13) vs direct homily hoi pistoi (PG 59 col. 361 C + Montfaucon/NPNF).

NAZ-1.basis: MASON-1899-TITLE-JPG + MASON-1899-P140..P143-JPG (A1 visual scans) + FIRST1K-NAZ-OR30-XML (A1 TEI) + OG-NAZ-OR45-JSONL (C OCR)
NAZ-1.finding: Verifies printed pp. 140-143 of Or. 30.20-21 (lytron at p. 141.8-9; anti-Apollinarian Assumption and loosing of the whole condemned humanity at p. 142.5-8; sphagion at p. 143.5-6); keeps Or. 45.22 Greek OCR strictly class C.

LEO-1.finding: Verifies Latin Ep. 124 cols. 1063-1065 (si universitas captivorum in redemptorem suum crederet, nullum tyrannica vincula retinerent; propitiatio fuit mundi) and Ep. 28 col. 766 (ad resolvendum conditionis nostrae debitum) + Chalcedonian Greek on fig70.jpg (pros to chreostoumenon ophlema tes hemeteras physeos ektithenai).
